# Capability Map

What the portfolio can do, and what covers each capability. The question this exists to answer is **"what do we already own that does this?"** — asked before a purchase, not after one.

## Capabilities covered more than once

Overlap is not automatically waste. Some of these are deliberate complements and some are duplication nobody has noticed; the map cannot tell them apart, and the point is that somebody now has to look.

| Capability | Applications | Covered by |
|---|---|---|
| Expense Management | 2 | [Expense Management](../apps/expense-management.md), [Travel & Expense (T&E)](../apps/travel-and-expense.md) |
| Financial Management | 2 | [Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)](../apps/meridian-erp.md), [Tax Engine](../apps/tax-engine.md) |
| Integration & Middleware | 2 | [EDI Gateway](../apps/edi-gateway.md), [Integration Platform (iPaaS)](../apps/integration-platform.md) |
| Inventory Management | 2 | [Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)](../apps/meridian-erp.md), [Warehouse Management (WMS)](../apps/warehouse-management.md) |
| Order Management | 2 | [Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)](../apps/meridian-erp.md), [Legacy Order Entry](../apps/legacy-order-entry.md) |
